rationale: Several papers contribute substantive new evidence on the nature and fate of giant clumps. Papers [2610.03867] and [2610.03866] explore the internal composition and scaling of giant clumps, [2606.05284] investigates their formation through metal-poor gas accretion, [2308.00041] examines their demographics, and [2501.03328] analyzes their influence on star formation. However, the question is not fully settled.
